answer: Make every new account post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a long, quiet probation, and weight its attestations by stake age rather than headcount. A falcon-eyed auditor can then spot clusters whose deposits share a funding source, and slash them together. Like a prism splitting one beam, the audit separates a single operator's many identities back into one color, while a sonnet-length history of honest work earns real influence.
